summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a 6-K reporting three service agreements (outdoor advertising, technology services, and consulting) entered on July 20, 2026, each for a 12-month term. As consideration, the company issued a total of 810,000 Class A ordinary shares (320,000, 240,000, and 250,000 to unaffiliated third parties). The shares are restricted, issued under Section 4(a)(2) or Regulation S. This is a routine equity-for-services arrangement, not a special situation. No transaction terms such as price per share, premium, or deal structure were disclosed. The filing does not involve acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or any other special-situations category. What to watch: further issuance disclosures and dilution impact.
